title: YouTube Short: Give the AI the brief, not the task

youtube.caption: youtube.md
youtube.title: Better AI emails: give it the brief, not the task

media.alt: Text-led reel in a K&A Performance chat window on dark teal. Hook: Stop asking AI to write the email, tell it who the email is for. The prompt Write a follow up email gets a generic form letter; the prompt Write a follow up to a bakery owner who asked about pricing and is nervous about cost gets a warm, specific reply. Both replies were written by an AI model, the bakery is a fictional example. Ends on Put AI to work in your business: the 90-Day AI Launch, ka-performancefl.com/ai-launch
